question: Approve the design and enter implementation as Pilot? Approving accepts the recommendations D1 (Sonnet for the security reviewer at both gates, one agent definition), D2 (a reviewer that returns no report or refuses holds the task, no automatic rerun or model switch), D3 (enforced by delivery_gate.py check at the merge ask plus the worker's acceptance script, no FO words), D4 (a new review for every new candidate head), and FO's implementation order below.

artifacts.summary: Measured, 14 runs at security_tier full: under the reviewer's own contract Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 all miss relay #347's unbounded write class (0 of 6); one added paragraph (the Reach brief) makes all three name it (4 of 4), and Sonnet returns no finding on a no-exposure control. 0 refusals in 14. Cost per review on Sonnet about 0.9 USD with the brief; Opus about 2.2, Fable about 12. The measurement itself cost about 36 USD assumed (ceiling about 150 USD; cache pricing assumed, output tokens estimated). Design: the brief in skills/validation/profiles/prod.md, new validation_security.py, 11 lines in delivery_gate.py; merge-ask words on a prod task 77 to 87; no workflow.md edit. Limits: the brief is fitted to one PR; AC-2 re-runs the shipped wording with at most two revisions; refusal tested on fixtures only. Implementation order (FO, from the six Batch overlap sections): workflow-budget-ratchet and prod-security-validation-gate first in parallel; after the ratchet merges, worker-loads-declared-package, ui-design-review-in-ideation and special-role-triggers; merge-gatekeeper after prod-security-validation-gate (both edit delivery_gate.py). At most three workers at once.
